page_title: OSA 1-1 BET | Osasuna v Betis 12/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Miguel Sesma has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
90+3' Substitution. Iker Munoz will be replaced by Lucas Torro (Osasuna).
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Alvaro Valles to get hold of the ball.
88' Betis are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
87' Rough tackle by Diego Llorente (Betis). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
86' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
85' The ball is cleared after Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
84' Decent spell from Betis here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in.

83' Nelson Deossa (Betis) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
81' Alessio Lisci prepares a substitution. Ante Budimir is replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
81' Substitution. Aimar Oroz leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
81' Betis control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

78' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Sergio Herrera was ready and made a save.
77' Betis are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
74' Substitution. Pablo Fornals makes way for Giovani Lo Celso (Betis).
74' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Sergi Altimira and he is replaced by Nelson Deossa (Betis).
74' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) tests the keeper with the free kick from the edge of the box, but the ball whistles inches wide of the left post. A slightly better aim and he could have scored.
72' Substitution. Ruben Garcia did his best and is replaced by Raul Moro (Osasuna).
71' The Osasuna players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
69' The Betis players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
67' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
67' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Juan Cruz (Osasuna).
64' One of the Osasuna players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
64' Osasuna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
62' Neat passing move from Betis in order to create new attacking opportunities.
61' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
60' Osasuna are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
59' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:2.
56' Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
55' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the top right corner and forces a good save out of Alvaro Valles.
55' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Javi Galan (Osasuna), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
54' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes.
53' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
49' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
47' Miguel Sesma has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jon Moncayola (Osasuna).
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Juan Cruz (Osasuna) will replace Jorge Herrando.
46' Here is a change. Hector Bellerin is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Aitor Ruibal (Betis).
46' A substitution has been made. Antony is replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Miguel Sesma has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Hector Bellerin (Betis) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

45+3' The Osasuna players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
44' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
43' Miguel Sesma blows his whistle as Javi Galan (Osasuna) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
41' Pablo Fornals (Betis) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Miguel Sesma saw the whole situation.
40' 1 - 1 Goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Alvaro Valles.
39' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
39' The referee gives a yellow card to Antony (Betis) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
38' Valentin Gomez (Betis) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Miguel Sesma blows for a foul. PENALTY! One of the players from Osasuna is about to take a penalty kick.

38' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) has good timing inside the box as he rises above the defence to meet a cross from the free kick. He directs his header towards the roof of the net, but Alvaro Valles makes a tremendous save and pushes the ball onto the crossbar.
37' The ball goes out of play and Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
36' Betis hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
34' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Sesma had an easy-decision to make.
34' The ball possession is 56:44.
32' Nice passing game by Osasuna. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
30' Two players stand over the free kick. Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
29' The game has begun to heat up. Hector Bellerin (Betis) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
28' Natan (Betis) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Sesma blows his whistle for an infringement.
25' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
24' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sergi Altimira (Betis) was quite harsh and Miguel Sesma didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
24' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

23' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the top left corner. Sergio Herrera pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
22' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
20' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
19' Osasuna are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
17' Betis enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
15' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Osasuna.
12' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates.
11' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the corner but it's cleared.
10' Hector Bellerin (Betis) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Sesma blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
8' Great teamplay by Osasuna as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is teed up on the edge of the box by Hector Bellerin, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom left corner gives the keeper no chance. 0:1.
6' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
5' Osasuna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
4' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Hector Bellerin (Betis).
2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Antony (Betis).
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Betis will have the kick-off.
Miguel Sesma is the one to supervise the game today.
